ghi_chu: Bang DONG (hinh dang, chan chuyen trach). Moi vet phai bi DUNG chan chuyen trach bat voi ma 1 — khong nhan 'mot chan nao do bat duoc'. Bang lech voi bo vet la thoat ma 2.

hinh_dang.ten: go phep ghi de nhan vung thong bao
hinh_dang.ghi_chu: Chan bat phai in thong diep chua NGUYEN VAN Notifications — day la doi chung duong cho AC-4, thay cho mot khang dinh phu dinh.

khong_co_doi_tuong.chuoi la moi tren man: Cam mot chuoi tieng Anh moi vao man thi no NAM trong file nguon, nen phep thu nguon tra ve 'co' va chan khong bat — dung thiet ke. Hinh dang nay khong co doi tuong cam duoc; chieu do that cua chan chu-la la vet 'go phep ghi de', vi no lam mot chuoi KHONG con trong file nguon nao xuat hien tro lai.
